name: Yoko
source: Yoko, born in The Empire's refugee district, is now a full-body cyborg except for her brain. She has always been involved in illegal activities under the cover of being an android dealer. She is known as the leader of the Red Moon gang, and is respected for being an unbeatable fighter.
